تستأنفين (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنِفِينَ (tastaʔnifīna) /tas.taʔ.ni.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# تُسْتَأْنَفِينَ (tustaʔnafīna) /tus.taʔ.na.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
